# PostgreSQL credential status

No permanent PostgreSQL password was created, reset, copied, or stored.

The authorized Supabase Management PAT was read from its private location for process lifetime only. Supabase Temporary Access/JIT supplied scoped `postgres` access to staging over TLS. The mapping was removed and JIT was returned to its initial disabled state after certification; a new connection was rejected.

No PAT, database password, URL, JWT, or connection string is recorded in this evidence.
